request_ownership: Only the immutable actual user request and attached appearance reference are requester owned. Public human contact is coordinator diversity guidance; the flower stall, paper handoff and all staging are authorial test choices.

independence_boundary.before_core: Only exact current SKILL.md, named neutral precore material, exact actual requester texts, supplied reference image and general knowledge.

appearance_scope: Reference-guided facial proportions, dark eyes and short black bob with wispy fringe; no claimed real identity or age.

observable_criteria.criterion: One folded paper is held at opposite edges by the woman's left hand and adjacent commuter's right hand; both hands, wrists, owners and paper can be traced together.
observable_criteria.failure: Missing/ambiguous paper, concealed contact, fused or untraceable hands, or partial component visibility fails the full transfer criterion.

observable_criteria.criterion: The two bodies share a discrete handoff while their public-facing attentions diverge, amid ordinary flower-stall/concourse activity.
observable_criteria.failure: A generic fashion portrait or ordinary face-to-face gift presentation without the divided-attention transfer does not pass.

observable_criteria.criterion: A flower counter and public commuter concourse are readable around the encounter.
observable_criteria.failure: Only isolated flowers or an empty portrait backdrop cannot prove this setting.

observable_criteria.criterion: Direct visual comparison supports broad face and short dark bob guidance.
observable_criteria.failure: Text attachment metadata alone cannot pass; exact biometric identity is not claimed.

limits: Espionage affiliation, paper contents, secrecy intent and prior/future chronology cannot be established as facts from one image.
Candidate retrieval, prompt audit, render transport, observed pixels and user acceptance are separate evidence layers.
